title: Testament of Leaves
author: Carolyn Ives Gilman
note: conf=0.9; SF mystery novella (120pp) published by Fairwood Press, 2026-08-18, ISBN 978-1958880302. The author's own bibliography page lists it under "The Twenty Planets Universe" alongside Halfway Human, Arkfall, The Ice Owl, and Dark Orbit; a Locus review also notes it belongs to the Twenty Planets sequence. The Twenty Planets is a shared-universe sequence of standalone, unnumbered works (Goodreads notes the stories are not directly connected), so no series number applies. Plot: inscrutinator Shameesh Kulkarni investigates a linguist's death on the planet Hant, aided by a digital replica of the victim and an octopod.
